findings.location: Paragraph beginning “So what really was wrong with Judson?”
findings.source_quote: “In retrospect, I see that spoiling him crept in unawares.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Ninapotazama nyuma, ninaona kwamba nilianza kumlemaza kwa kumfuatafuata bila kujua.” with “Ninapotazama nyuma, ninaona kwamba bila kujua nilianza kumlea kwa kumharibu.”
findings.translation_quote: “Ninapotazama nyuma, ninaona kwamba nilianza kumlemaza kwa kumfuatafuata bila kujua.”

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Somewhere in the transition between need and demand…”
findings.source_quote: “Somewhere in the transition between need and demand, I began to cater to his little self.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “nilianza kujifanyia yote aliyotaka mtoto wangu mdogo” with “nilianza kutimiza matakwa ya mtoto wangu mdogo.”
findings.translation_quote: “Wakati fulani katika mabadiliko kati ya hitaji na madai, nilianza kujifanyia yote aliyotaka mtoto wangu mdogo.”
